description: A synthetic but realistic benchmark for testing GrowthPilot's ability to review creator-submitted campaign content. The suite separates hard blocking issues, campaign requirement coverage, quality advisories, and clean negative controls.
design_principles: All brands, products, creators, and campaign materials are synthetic.
Blocking findings must be grounded in explicit supplied product facts or policy constraints.
Missing required campaign information is evaluated separately from compliance blocking.
Subjective quality issues such as tone and creator fit are advisory rather than blocking unless an explicit rule is supplied.
Negative controls are included to measure false blocking behavior.
A problematic campaign brief does not make the final creator draft blocking when the creator safely ignores the problematic instruction.

cases.brand_info: LumiSkin is a modern skincare brand focused on simple, barrier-supportive daily skincare. The brand communicates in a calm, professional, trustworthy, and modern tone. LumiSkin does not position its cosmetic products as medical treatments.
cases.product_info: Product: LumiSkin Barrier Repair Moisturizer. Key ingredients: ceramides and hyaluronic acid. Designed for dry and sensitive skin. Lightweight and non-greasy texture. Provides up to 24 hours of hydration.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a Xiaohongshu creator post introducing LumiSkin Barrier Repair Moisturizer as part of a simple daily skincare routine for young consumers with dry or sensitive skin.

creator_profile.creator_style: Personal skincare diary, relaxed and experience-driven
creator_profile.content_characteristics: First-person recommendation with everyday skincare scenarios

cases.additional_policy_context: Do not claim that the product treats or cures eczema, dermatitis, or any other disease. Do not describe the moisturizer as a medical treatment.
cases.creator_draft: 最近换季皮肤状态很不稳定，我用了 LumiSkin 一段时间之后最大的感受就是它真的把我的湿疹治好了。神经酰胺和透明质酸的搭配也很适合日常保湿，一次可以维持最长24小时，肤感不会很厚重。

blocking_issues.evidence: 它真的把我的湿疹治好了
blocking_issues.policy_basis: Do not claim that the product treats or cures eczema, dermatitis, or any other disease.
blocking_issues.required_action: Remove the disease-treatment statement and retain only explicitly supported skincare information.

cases.scenario_name: Incorrect Numerical Specification and Invented Capability
cases.brand_info: VoltGo is a practical consumer electronics brand. Its communication should be clear, technical, and useful without exaggeration.
cases.product_info: Product: VoltGo Mini Power Bank. Capacity: 10,000mAh. Maximum wired charging output: 20W. Weight: 180g. Two USB-C ports. Wired charging only. Wireless charging is not supported.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a short Douyin creator script introducing VoltGo Mini as a portable charging option for commuters and students.
cases.additional_policy_context: Maximum wired charging output is 20W. The product does not support wireless charging. Product specifications must not be changed or strengthened.
cases.creator_draft: 最近通勤我一直带这个 VoltGo Mini，10,000mAh 但只有180克，放包里基本没什么负担。它支持30W有线快充，而且临时不想接线的时候还可以直接无线充电，学生党日常带一个真的很方便。

blocking_issues.required_action: Replace 30W with the supported maximum wired output of 20W.

blocking_issues.policy_basis: The product does not support wireless charging.

cases.brand_info: PureCalm is a gentle skincare brand focused on simple daily cleansing for sensitive skin. The brand communicates carefully and avoids unsupported scientific or medical claims.
cases.product_info: Product: PureCalm Gentle Cleanser. Fragrance-free formula. Designed for daily facial cleansing. Contains glycerin. No clinical study, dermatologist certification, or user-percentage study has been supplied for this campaign.
cases.campaign_brief: Create an educational Xiaohongshu post introducing a simple evening cleansing routine.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Explains products through simple skincare knowledge

cases.additional_policy_context: No clinical study results, dermatologist certification, or user-percentage efficacy data have been provided. Do not invent such evidence.
cases.creator_draft: 敏感肌晚间清洁我最近会用 PureCalm Gentle Cleanser，无香精配方加上甘油，整体思路比较简单。更让我放心的是，临床测试显示95%的用户使用后敏感泛红明显改善，所以敏感期也可以放心用。

blocking_issues.evidence: 临床测试显示95%的用户使用后敏感泛红明显改善
blocking_issues.policy_basis: No clinical study results, dermatologist certification, or user-percentage efficacy data have been provided.
blocking_issues.required_action: Remove the invented clinical-study and user-percentage claim.

cases.brand_info: NorthNote develops AI tools for professional teams. Its communication style is professional, precise, calm, and credible.
cases.product_info: Product: NorthNote AI Meeting Notes. Features include automatic meeting summaries, action-item extraction, searchable meeting history, and team knowledge organization.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a LinkedIn creator post introducing NorthNote to managers and professional teams who spend significant time in meetings.
must_avoid: Guarantees that nothing will ever be missed
cases.additional_policy_context: Do not claim 100% accuracy. Do not guarantee that NorthNote will ensure no action item, decision, or meeting detail is ever missed.
cases.creator_draft: NorthNote automatically summarizes meetings and extracts action items, which can make follow-up much easier for busy teams. Most importantly, it guarantees that your team will never miss another action item or important decision again.

blocking_issues.evidence: it guarantees that your team will never miss another action item or important decision again
blocking_issues.policy_basis: Do not guarantee that NorthNote will ensure no action item, decision, or meeting detail is ever missed.
blocking_issues.required_action: Remove the absolute guarantee while preserving the supported product capabilities.

cases.brand_info: BeanTrail is a modern coffee brand positioned around convenient everyday coffee routines. Its tone is friendly, relaxed, and contemporary.
cases.product_info: Product: BeanTrail Cold Brew Concentrate. Made with 100% Arabica coffee. No added sugar. Approximately 8 servings per bottle. Can be mixed with water or milk.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a Xiaohongshu student lifestyle post showing how BeanTrail can fit into a busy morning routine.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Dorm life, study routines, and everyday recommendations

cases.additional_policy_context: Do not claim that the product improves concentration, memory, academic performance, exam results, weight loss, or health outcomes.
cases.creator_draft: 早八的时候我最近会直接用 BeanTrail 冷萃浓缩液兑水，100% Arabica 而且没有额外加糖，准备起来很方便。考试周喝它之后专注力真的明显提升，复习效率至少翻了一倍。

blocking_issues.evidence: 考试周喝它之后专注力真的明显提升，复习效率至少翻了一倍
blocking_issues.policy_basis: Do not claim that the product improves concentration, memory, academic performance, exam results, weight loss, or health outcomes.
blocking_issues.required_action: Remove the concentration and academic-efficiency claims while preserving the supported product information.

cases.brand_info: AeroBottle is an active-lifestyle drinkware brand. Communication should be clean, practical, and straightforward.
cases.product_info: Product: AeroBottle Pro. Capacity: 600ml. Stainless steel construction. Keeps drinks cold for up to 18 hours. Leak-resistant lid. Weight: 280g. BPA-free. Available in four colors.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a short Instagram creator caption for students and young professionals commuting to school or work.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Short captions built around commuting and everyday carry

cases.additional_policy_context: This campaign must mention that AeroBottle Pro keeps drinks cold for up to 18 hours and that it is BPA-free.
cases.creator_draft: My new everyday commute bottle: 600ml stainless steel, lightweight enough for my work bag, and keeps my water cold for up to 18 hours. The leak-resistant lid has also been really useful when I am moving between classes and work.

required_missing.policy_basis: This campaign must mention that AeroBottle Pro keeps drinks cold for up to 18 hours and that it is BPA-free.
required_missing.required_action: Add the BPA-free product fact without changing the creator's overall style.

cases.scenario_name: Brand Tone Misalignment Without Factual Error
cases.brand_info: Maison Verda is a premium botanical skincare brand. The brand aims to feel refined, calm, modern, and understated. Communication usually avoids hard-selling language and emphasizes thoughtful daily rituals.
cases.product_info: Product: Maison Verda Botanical Cleansing Balm. Removes makeup and daily impurities. Contains camellia oil. Soft balm texture that emulsifies with water.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a Xiaohongshu creator post introducing the cleansing balm as part of an evening skincare routine.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Conversational product recommendations with strong hooks

cases.additional_policy_context: Brand communication should feel refined, calm, modern, and understated. Tone preference is advisory unless an explicit factual or policy conflict exists.
cases.creator_draft: 姐妹们这个卸妆膏真的给我冲！！！山茶花油加上遇水乳化的质地，晚上卸妆的时候用起来很方便。最近我的晚间护肤第一步基本就是它，懒人真的会爱死这种用法哈哈哈。

advisory_focus: The highly excited hard-selling tone may not match the brand's refined and understated positioning.
The creator voice can be preserved while softening the strongest promotional expressions.

cases.brand_info: NorthNote develops AI productivity tools for professional teams. Its brand communication is clear, credible, and practical.
cases.product_info: Product: NorthNote AI Meeting Notes. Automatic summaries, action-item extraction, searchable meeting history, and team knowledge organization.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a LinkedIn post introducing NorthNote to operations managers and consulting teams.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Business frameworks, concise workplace observations, and practical recommendations

cases.additional_policy_context: Professional platform fit and creator-style fit should be evaluated as quality advisories unless an explicit hard rule is violated.
cases.creator_draft: POV: your meeting ends and you actually remember what happened 😂🔥 NorthNote makes automatic summaries and pulls out action items so your team does not have to dig through notes afterwards. Honestly kinda obsessed with this workflow rn!!!

advisory_focus: The highly casual social style is mismatched with the specified professional LinkedIn creator profile.
The core product facts remain supported and therefore should not be treated as blocking.

cases.scenario_name: Unsafe Campaign Brief but Safe Creator Draft
cases.brand_info: LumiSkin is a modern skincare brand focused on simple daily skincare for dry and sensitive skin. The brand tone is calm, trustworthy, and professional.
cases.product_info: Product: LumiSkin Barrier Repair Moisturizer. Contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid. Lightweight and non-greasy. Provides up to 24 hours of hydration.
cases.campaign_brief: The campaign manager asks the creator to emphasize that the product can cure sensitive-skin problems and completely repair damaged skin.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Daily routine content with moderate product explanation

cases.additional_policy_context: Brand restrictions override conflicting campaign requests. Do not claim that the product cures skin conditions or guarantees complete skin repair.
cases.creator_draft: 换季的时候我会更偏向简单一点的护肤步骤。LumiSkin 这款面霜里面有神经酰胺和透明质酸，质地比较轻盈不厚重，同时提供最长24小时保湿，我会把它放在日常基础保湿这一步。

gold.special_test_objective: The system must judge the final creator draft rather than treating the unsafe campaign request itself as evidence of a final-content violation.

cases.brand_info: VoltGo is a practical consumer electronics brand. Its communication is technical, straightforward, and useful without exaggerated promises.
cases.product_info: Product: VoltGo Mini Power Bank. Capacity: 10,000mAh. Maximum wired charging output: 20W. Weight: 180g. Two USB-C ports. Wired charging only.
cases.campaign_brief: Create a Douyin creator script for students and young professionals who need portable charging during commuting and long days outside.

creator_profile.content_characteristics: Concise demonstrations focused on daily usefulness

cases.additional_policy_context: Do not claim wireless charging. Do not claim charging output above the supported maximum wired output of 20W.
cases.creator_draft: 如果你平时通勤时间比较长，可以看看这种小体积充电宝。VoltGo Mini 是10,000mAh，重量180克，最高支持20W有线输出，还有两个USB-C接口。我比较喜欢这种参数写得清楚、放包里也不会太占空间的产品。
